chunks: From him, from al-‘Abbās ibn Ma‘rūf, from ‘Abd Allāh ibn al-Mughīrah, from Ibn Sinān, from Abū ‘Abd Allāh عليه السلام, who said:

If a mu’adhdhin gives the adhan and omits part of the adhan, and you wish to perform salat (prayer) with his adhan, then complete what he omitted from his adhan. And there is no harm in the boy who has not yet reached puberty giving the adhan.

key_terms.أَذَّنَ: gave the adhan; made the call to prayer
key_terms.فَأَتِمَّ: then complete; finish what is lacking
key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: there is no harm; it is permissible
key_terms.مُؤَذِّنٌ: the one who calls the adhan
key_terms.يَحْتَلِمْ: reaches puberty through experiencing a wet dream
key_terms.ٱلْأَذَانَ: the adhan, the call announcing salat (prayer)

ai.seo_question: What should be done if a mu’adhdhin omits part of the adhan, and can a boy who has not reached puberty give the adhan?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning the adhan. If a mu’adhdhin leaves out part of the adhan, the missing portion may be completed, and it also permits a prepubescent boy to give the adhan.
